info.name: TYRAG device integration · FILE_SHARE v3 + query v2
info.description: P0 local device flow. The v3 poll request uses the statusUrl returned by registration; no live result is implied by this export.

item.name: FILE_SHARE v3 · HMAC
item.description: Service-to-service FILE_SHARE v3 requests. Set hmacSecret in Postman Vault for manual runs; Newman uses the ignored local environment.

exec: (async function () {
function enc(value) { return encodeURIComponent(String(value)).replace(/[!'()*]/g, function (c) { return '%' + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).toUpperCase(); }); }
function dec(value) { return decodeURIComponent(String(value).replace(/\+/g, ' ')); }
function canonicalPathQuery(path, query) {
var targetPath = enc(decodeURIComponent(path || '/')).replace(/%2F/gi, '/');

var pairs = []; String(query || '').split('&').forEach(function (part) { if (!part) return; var i = part.indexOf('='); var k = i < 0 ? part : part.slice(0, i); var v = i < 0 ? '' : part.slice(i + 1); pairs.push([enc(dec(k)), enc(dec(v))]); });
return pairs.length ? targetPath + '?' + pairs.map(function (pair) { return pair[0] + '=' + pair[1]; }).join('&') : targetPath;

async function readSecret(name) { var value = ''; try { if (pm.vault && typeof pm.vault.get === 'function') value = await pm.vault.get(name); } catch (error) { value = ''; } return String(value || pm.variables.get(name) || ''); }
var keyId = String(pm.variables.get('keyId') || ''); var secret = await readSecret('hmacSecret'); if (!keyId || !secret) throw new Error('keyId and hmacSecret are required');

var configured = String(pm.variables.get('hmacTimestamp') || ''); var timestamp = /^\d{10}$/.test(configured) ? configured : String(Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)); if (!/^\d{10}$/.test(timestamp)) throw new Error('timestamp must be a ten-digit epoch value');

var path = pm.request.url.getPath(); var query = pm.request.url.getQueryString(); var rawBody = pm.request.body && pm.request.body.mode === 'raw' ? pm.variables.replaceIn(pm.request.body.raw || '') : '';

var bodyHash = CryptoJS.SHA256(CryptoJS.enc.Utf8.parse(rawBody)).toString(CryptoJS.enc.Hex); var canonical = ['v1', timestamp, pm.request.method.toUpperCase(), canonicalPathQuery(path, query), bodyHash].join('\n');

var digest = CryptoJS.HmacSHA256(canonical, secret).toString(CryptoJS.enc.Hex); pm.request.headers.upsert({ key: 'X-TY-Timestamp', value: timestamp }); pm.request.headers.upsert({ key: 'X-TY-Key-Id', value: keyId }); pm.request.headers.upsert({ key: 'X-TY-Signature', value: 'v1=' + digest });
pm.test('registration is accepted', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(202); });
var payload = pm.response.json(); pm.test('registration returns statusUrl', function () { pm.expect(typeof payload.statusUrl).to.eql('string'); pm.expect(payload.statusUrl).to.not.eql(''); });
pm.environment.set('statusUrl', payload.statusUrl || ''); pm.environment.set('operationId', payload.operationId || '');
pm.test('duplicate registration is accepted', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(202); });
pm.test('duplicate registration is marked deduplicated', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().deduplicated).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('status response is successful', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); });
var payload = pm.response.json(); var attempt = Number(pm.environment.get('pollAttempt') || '0'); var maxAttempts = Number(pm.environment.get('maxPollAttempts') || '10');

pm.test('status belongs to the registered FILE_SHARE document', function () { pm.expect(payload.externalDocumentId).to.eql(pm.environment.get('externalDocumentId')); pm.expect(payload.sourceKind).to.eql('FILE_SHARE'); });

if (payload.retrievable === true) { pm.test('payload.retrievable is true', function () { pm.expect(payload.retrievable).to.eql(true); }); pm.environment.set('pollAttempt', '0'); } else { var nextAttempt = attempt + 1; pm.environment.set('pollAttempt', String(nextAttempt)); if (nextAttempt < maxAttempts) { pm.execution.setNextRequest('FILE_SHARE v3 · poll response statusUrl'); } else { pm.execution.setNextRequest(null); pm.expect.fail('FILE_SHARE document did not become retrievable within maxPollAttempts'); } }
pm.request.headers.upsert({ key: 'X-TY-Signature', value: 'v1=' + '0'.repeat(64) });
pm.test('invalid HMAC is rejected', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(401); });
pm.test('invalid HMAC has a stable error code', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('AUTH_SIGNATURE_INVALID'); });
pm.test('missing source registration is accepted for async processing', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(202); });
var payload = pm.response.json(); if (payload.statusUrl) pm.environment.set('missingStatusUrl', payload.statusUrl);

item.name: FILE_SHARE v3 · missing document status error

exec: pm.test('missing document is rejected', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(404); });
pm.test('missing document has a stable error code', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND'); });

item.name: JWT v2 · session and messages
item.description: Formal user flow. Bearer JWT is read from the userJwt variable; the local generator creates the Gateway HS256 test claim shape.

exec: pm.test('session is created', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(201); });
var payload = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(payload.conversationId).to.be.a('string'); pm.environment.set('conversationId', payload.conversationId);

body.raw: {"clientMessageId":"{{messageIdOne}}","question":"请说明设备当前故障的检查步骤。"}

exec: pm.test('question round 1 returns a run result', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); });

var payload = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(['completed', 'no_reliable_evidence', 'failed']).to.include(payload.status); if (payload.citations && payload.citations[0]) pm.environment.set('citationId', payload.citations[0].citationId);

body.raw: {"clientMessageId":"{{messageIdTwo}}","question":"请说明该设备的维护周期和注意事项。"}

exec: pm.test('question round 2 returns a run result', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); });

var payload = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(['completed', 'no_reliable_evidence', 'failed']).to.include(payload.status); if (payload.citations && payload.citations[0]) pm.environment.set('citationId', payload.citations[0].citationId);
pm.test('history is readable', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); });

pm.test('history preserves message status and citations independently', function () { var payload = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(payload.items).to.be.an('array'); payload.items.forEach(function (item) { pm.expect(['completed', 'no_reliable_evidence', 'failed']).to.include(item.status); pm.expect(item.citations).to.be.an('array'); }); });
pm.test('citation detail is readable', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); });
pm.expect(pm.response.json().citationId).to.eql(pm.environment.get('citationId'));
pm.test('citation source is readable', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); });
pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.match(/application\/(pdf|octet-stream)/i);
pm.test('invalid JWT is rejected', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(401); });
pm.test('invalid JWT has a stable error code', function () { pm.expect(['AUTH_TOKEN_MISSING', 'AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID']).to.include(pm.response.json().code); });
